versions.changelog:
Initial release of hazmat-disposal-router:

- Provides item-by-item disposal guidance (trash, HHW facility, take-back, retailer drop-off) with concise explanations.
- Includes multi-item audit mode to group hazardous materials and optimize drop-off trips.
- Offers safe interim storage rules for common hazardous items.
- Supplies local take-back and recycling channel information for US, EU, and UK.
- Features a never-do list with safety warnings and reasons.
- Pure stdlib, offline; verdicts based on general best practices—users should confirm local regulations.
